# `aitbc explorer block`

Get a block by its height on the specified chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer block [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--height` | integer | — | yes | The Height. |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer block --height <height>
```
